The last thing job creators need is more red tape. 

That's why I reintroduced the bipartisan Commonsense Reporting Act to streamline health coverage reporting requirements for employers.

Thanks to @RepThompson for partnering with me on the House version of this legislation!

There is still work to be done. Mexico must be held to all its USCMA commitments, particularly regarding agriculture & policies related to biotech. I urge the administration to push for enforcement of all elements of the USMCA to ensure U.S. industries receive fair treatment.

Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers  & Critical Access Hospitals play a vital role in rural & underserved areas.

I hope we can work in a true bipartisan fashion to address gaps in policy and set a long-term, sustainable course for telehealth.👇 https://t.co/zqKb8fSsa2

The bills marked up by @WaysandMeansGOP today, including my bipartisan bill to expand Medicare mental health coverage, represent an important step and show just how much can still be accomplished on a bipartisan basis. https://t.co/hHzhloLZL0

.@CDCgov & @CMSGov removing some masking, testing, and visitation restrictions at long-term care facilities last week is too little, too late. 

Today I urged them to provide further relief for patients and staff in long term care and assisted living facilities. https://t.co/BAvaEdxkjm

Recently, I joined @RepGregPence in a letter to @CMSGov opposing President Biden’s proposed staffing rule for nursing homes. Piling on regulations in the midst of a workforce shortage only makes it more difficult for skilled nursing care facilities to serve patients. https://t.co/KhQdrkzS4N

The end of the Public Health Emergency is fast approaching. While this is long overdue, we must take steps to provide patients, especially seniors, certainty by maintaining the commonsense flexibilities that have expanded their health care options.

Our bill, the Equitable Community Access to Pharmacist Services Act, would continue Medicare coverage of pharmacist-administered tests, vaccines & treatments for common respiratory illnesses. @RepSchneider, @RepLarryBucshon, @DorisMatsui, @RepBuddyCarter & @RepHarshbarger

While I welcome the end of the Public Health Emergency, the Biden administration must work with Congress to ensure patients, especially those in rural areas, can access the health care services they need. 

I asked Secretary Becerra about this today ⤵️ https://t.co/hU7GRQAKAa

It was a pleasure to address the @ahahospitals #AHAMtg on bipartisan ways we can empower health providers to deliver care to patients in every community. Thank you to @NordquistNHA for the introduction. https://t.co/J8Rx5qCsz5

Patients face too much uncertainty and lack information about the cost of their health care.

We must work together to empower consumers with information to help them avoid unnecessary, unexpected costs.

Watch my statement at today's @waysandmeansgop hearing.⬇️ https://t.co/QMDoEjbEWM

My bill, the Equitable Community Access to Pharmacist Services Act, is a bipartisan effort to provide seniors more options for care by allowing Medicare to reimburse pharmacists for testing, treatment, and vaccination for common respiratory diseases. https://t.co/dwufy8e401

This week I hosted a congressional briefing on my bipartisan bill, the ECAPS Act, which would ensure seniors’ access to essential pharmacist services by continuing Medicare coverage of pharmacist-administered tests and treatments for common respiratory illnesses. https://t.co/d0pJmHAChO

Happy Rural Health Day! With 58 Critical Access Hospitals and over 100 Rural Health Clinics, #NE03 is a national leader in rural health care. Supporting the work of rural providers and promoting health care access for our communities is one of my top priorities in Congress. https://t.co/psVBvRhEvD

In May, I introduced a resolution with @RepDelBene, @RepMalliotakis, and @RepJudyChu calling for bilateral tax engagement with Taiwan.
 
This bill fulfills our call, ensuring American companies receive fair tax treatment abroad and strengthening economic partnership with Taiwan. https://t.co/WNozMTUBnY

Congressional support for my bipartisan ECAPS bill has exceeded 100 cosponsors in the House! Medicare's coverage policies should reflect the critical role pharmacists play in combating common respiratory illnesses and keeping our communities healthy.
https://t.co/iol2KUkNI0

I was honored to speak at an @OfficialNAHC briefing for my bill, the Preserving Access to Home Health Act. This legislation would promote seniors’ access to home care by halting counterproductive Medicare payment cuts and increasing transparency in payment policy calculations. https://t.co/gdzW4xWgVh

It was a joy to meet Nebraskans participating in @ruralhealth’s Rural Health Policy Institute. With more than 50 Critical Access Hospitals and 100 Rural Health Clinics, #NE03 has unique healthcare needs I am working to address through Medicare modernization and innovation. https://t.co/WFdMs4evhd

New technologies have the potential to change the game for health care access in rural communities like #NE03.

See my remarks in today’s @waysandmeansGOP hearing on my work to reduce barriers to home-based health care.⤵ https://t.co/0lxG9tonbV

#NE03 patients depend on PAs, nurse practitioners, and clinical nurse specialists, as well as doctors, for primary care. This week, I introduced a bipartisan, bicameral bill to remove barriers to provider participation in Medicare Accountable Care Orgs. https://t.co/PHXjrQ7N8N

I was recently named among @BudgetHawks’ 2024 Fiscal Heroes. After four years under Pres. Biden’s inflationary spending policies, we must get our economy moving again, address the real drivers of our debt, and safeguard Social Security and Medicare from insolvency. https://t.co/WaPEwtwJnn

In today’s @waysandmeansGOP Health Subcommittee hearing, I opposed Biden nursing home staffing rule which 90% of Neb. facilities won't be able to meet. Alongside workforce shortages, this mandate will hurt rural areas most.

I am a cosponsor of @RepFischbach’s bill to block it. https://t.co/RcNXpIpVtL

This afternoon I welcomed @CIPAToday members to my office. Federal crop insurance is a major component of the Farm Bill, and I am committed to ensuring American producers have the necessary risk management tools to prepare for disaster. https://t.co/27dnuONM1i

I am saddened by my Ways and Means colleague Bill Pascrell's passing. Bill was a fierce advocate on the committee for his constituents, working tirelessly for fair treatment of hardworking Americans. My prayers go out for his family.

Alarmingly, more than half of U.S. adults have been diagnosed with a chronic disease. Encouraging active health management is vital to reversing this trend.

Today in @waysandmeansgop I spoke on my efforts to increase access to primary care and effective disease prevention. https://t.co/AWaHjUCosa
